entries.head: ask out

senses.en: to invite someone you like on a date

example.en: He asked her out after three weeks of chatting.
example.zh: 聊了三周他终于约她出去了。

entries.l1_note: 约出去是 ask someone out，代词夹中间。

entries.head: go out with

senses.en: to be in a romantic relationship with someone

example.en: They've been going out with each other for a year.
example.zh: 他们在一起一年了。

entries.l1_note: 交往是 go out with；出门玩是 go out。

entries.head: fall for

senses.en: to start to love someone

example.en: I fell for her the first time we met.
example.zh: 第一次见面我就喜欢上她了。

entries.l1_note: 爱上 是 fall for；也指“上当”。

entries.head: drift apart

senses.en: to slowly become less close

example.en: We drifted apart after he moved to Beijing.
example.zh: 他去北京之后我们就慢慢淡了。

entries.l1_note: 疏远是 drift apart，画面是两条船漂开。

entries.head: cheat on

senses.en: to be unfaithful to a partner

example.en: She found out he'd been cheating on her.
example.zh: 她发现他一直出轨。

entries.l1_note: 出轨是 cheat on someone；cheat at 是考试作弊。

entries.head: fool around

senses.en: to behave in a casual or dishonest way

example.en: He's not ready to commit — he's still fooling around.
example.zh: 他还不想认真，还在玩。

entries.l1_note: fool around 也指瞎闹、浪费时间。

entries.head: grow on

senses.zh: 一开始一般，后来越来越顺眼
senses.en: to start to like someone or something gradually

example.en: He was a bit quiet at first, but he grows on you.
example.zh: 他一开始有点闷，但越处越喜欢。

entries.l1_note: 越来越喜欢是 grow on you；不是“长在你身上”。

example.en: I'm starting to like this neighborhood.
example.zh: 我开始喜欢这个小区了。

entries.head: lean on

senses.en: to depend on someone for support

example.en: She leaned on her sister during the divorce.
example.zh: 离婚那段时间她靠姐姐撑着。

entries.l1_note: 依靠是 lean on；lean 单独是倾斜。

entries.head: check in on

senses.en: to see how someone is doing

example.en: I called to check in on my grandma.
example.zh: 我打电话问问我奶奶怎么样。

entries.l1_note: 关心是 check in on；check on 也可以。

entries.head: look in on

senses.en: to visit someone briefly to see how they are

example.en: I'll look in on him after work.
example.zh: 下班后我去看看他。

entries.l1_note: 探望是 look in on；look into 是调查。

example.en: She asked how your mom is doing.
example.zh: 她问你妈最近怎么样。

entries.head: hear from

senses.en: to receive news from someone

example.en: I haven't heard from him since the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼之后就没他消息了。

entries.l1_note: 收到消息是 hear from；hear about 是听说某事。

entries.head: hold together

senses.en: to stay united or in one piece

example.en: The family held together through the hard year.
example.zh: 那艰难的一年一家人没散。

entries.l1_note: 维系是 hold together；hold on 是坚持住。

entries.head: work at

senses.en: to put effort into something over time

example.en: A marriage takes work — you have to work at it.
example.zh: 婚姻要经营，得一直用心。

entries.l1_note: 经营是 work at；work on 是改进某事。

entries.head: put behind

senses.en: to stop thinking about a bad experience

example.en: She put the breakup behind her and moved cities.
example.zh: 她把分手放下了，搬去了别的城市。

entries.l1_note: 放下过去是 put behind you；不是 forget it（太绝对）。

entries.head: move on

senses.en: to start a new stage after something ends

example.en: It took her a year to move on.
example.zh: 她花了一年才走出来。

entries.l1_note: move on 是继续往前；move in 是搬进去。

entries.head: make it up to

senses.en: to do something good for someone you wronged

example.en: I forgot our anniversary — I'll make it up to you.
example.zh: 我忘了纪念日，我会补偿你的。

entries.l1_note: 补偿某人是 make it up to someone；it 固定不能省。

entries.head: talk out

senses.en: to discuss a problem until it is resolved

example.en: We talked it out and decided to try again.
example.zh: 我们把话说开，决定再试一次。

entries.l1_note: 说开是 talk out；talk over 是商量。

entries.head: stick together

senses.en: to stay loyal and support each other

example.en: Whatever happens, we stick together.
example.zh: 不管怎样，我们得互相撑着。

entries.l1_note: 互相扶持是 stick together；stick with 是坚持不换。

entries.head: stand by
entries.zh: 站在某人一边；袖手旁观；坚持（信念）

senses.en: to support someone in a difficult time

example.en: Her friends stood by her through the whole thing.
example.zh: 整件事里朋友一直站在她这边。

senses.en: to watch something bad happen without helping

example.en: We can't stand by while the team burns out.
example.zh: 团队快撑不住了，我们不能袖手旁观。

senses.en: to continue to believe something is right

example.en: She stood by her decision despite the criticism.
example.zh: 尽管有批评，她仍坚持自己的决定。

entries.l1_note: 支持是 stand by someone；stand in 是代替。

entries.head: put down roots

senses.en: to settle in a place for a long time

example.en: They put down roots in Chengdu after the baby came.
example.zh: 孩子出生后他们在成都扎了根。

entries.l1_note: 扎根是 put down roots；不是“放下根”。
collocations: put down roots in a city

entries.head: look up to

senses.en: to admire and respect someone

example.en: The younger kids look up to him.
example.zh: 小一点的孩子都敬重他。

entries.l1_note: 敬重是 look up to；look down on 是看不起。

entries.head: grow up

senses.en: to become an adult

example.en: She grew up in a small town near Harbin.
example.zh: 她在哈尔滨附近的小镇长大。

entries.l1_note: 长大是 grow up；grow into 是长成某种样子。

entries.head: bring together

senses.en: to make people come together

example.en: The wedding brought the two families together.
example.zh: 婚礼把两家人聚到了一起。

entries.l1_note: 撮合是 bring together；bring up 是养大。

entries.head: pair off

senses.en: when people form pairs

example.en: By the end of the night everyone had paired off.
example.zh: 到散场时大家都各自成对了。

entries.l1_note: 配对是 pair off；pair up 是合作配对。

entries.head: break away

senses.en: to separate from a group or person

example.en: He broke away from the family business at thirty.
example.zh: 他三十岁时脱离了家族生意。

entries.l1_note: 脱离是 break away (from)；break up 是分手。

entries.head: walk out on

senses.en: to leave someone you are responsible for

example.en: He walked out on his family and never came back.
example.zh: 他抛下家人再没回来。

entries.l1_note: 抛下是 walk out on；walk out 是退场。

entries.head: run off with

senses.en: to leave with someone or take something secretly

example.en: She ran off with her business partner.
example.zh: 她跟生意伙伴跑了。

entries.l1_note: 跟人跑是 run off with；run away 是逃走。

entries.head: take after

senses.en: to look or behave like an older relative

example.en: She takes after her dad — same laugh and same temper.
example.zh: 她像她爸，笑声和脾气都一样。

entries.l1_note: 像家人是 take after；look like 只指外貌。

entries.head: bring up

senses.en: to care for a child until they are an adult

example.en: My parents brought me up in a small town near Hangzhou.
example.zh: 我父母在杭州附近的小镇把我养大。

senses.en: to start talking about a subject

example.en: Don't bring up salary in the first interview.
example.zh: 第一次面试别主动提薪资。

entries.l1_note: 代词要夹在中间：bring it up。bring up 不是“带上来”，养孩子和提话题都靠上下文区分。

entries.head: run away

senses.en: to leave a place or person by running

example.en: The cat ran away when the door was left open.
example.zh: 门没关好，猫跑了。

senses.en: to avoid dealing with a problem

example.en: You can't run away from this conversation forever.
example.zh: 这件事你不能一直躲着不谈。

entries.l1_note: run away from 才是“从……跑开/逃避”；只说 run away 就是跑掉，别说 run away the problem。

entries.head: grow apart

senses.en: to become less close over time

example.en: We used to text every day, but we've grown apart since college.
example.zh: 我们以前天天发消息，大学毕业后就慢慢疏远了。

entries.l1_note: grow apart 的主语通常是两个人；不能说 grow apart someone。

entries.head: pass away

senses.en: to die, used politely

example.en: Her grandmother passed away last winter at ninety.
example.zh: 她奶奶去年冬天去世了，享年九十岁。

entries.l1_note: pass away 是委婉说法；别用来形容物品“没了”，那叫 be gone。

entries.head: finish with

senses.en: 与……结束

example.en: She finished with her boyfriend last week.
example.zh: 她上周跟男朋友分手了。

entries.l1_note: finish with someone 可指分手；finish 是完成。

entries.head: sleep with

senses.en: 与……上床

example.en: They slept with each other on the second date.
example.zh: 他们第二次约会就上床了。

entries.l1_note: sleep with someone 是性关系；不是“一起睡”。

entries.head: bust up

senses.en: 分手；破裂

example.en: They busted up after three years together.
example.zh: 在一起三年后他们分手了。

entries.l1_note: bust up 是分手/破裂；口语。

entries.head: run after

senses.en: 追求

example.en: He's been running after her for months.
example.zh: 他追她好几个月了。

entries.l1_note: run after + 人；不是“在后面跑”。

entries.head: snuggle up

senses.en: 依偎

example.en: They snuggled up on the couch.
example.zh: 他们在沙发上依偎着。

entries.l1_note: snuggle up 是不及物；snuggle up to + 人。

entries.head: stick by

senses.en: 支持

example.en: She stuck by him through the tough year.
example.zh: 艰难的一年里她一直支持他。

entries.l1_note: stick by + 人/决定；不是“粘在旁边”。

entries.head: have someone to thank

senses.en: 多亏某人

example.en: I have my roommate to thank for the job lead.
example.zh: 这份工作线索多亏了我室友。

entries.l1_note: have someone to thank for + 事；不是“感谢某人”。

entries.head: sleep together

senses.en: 上床

example.en: They slept together after the third date.
example.zh: 第三次约会后他们上床了。

entries.l1_note: sleep together 是性关系；不是“一起睡”。

example.en: We celebrate the new year at my parents' place.
example.zh: 我们在爸妈家过新年。

example.en: We put up decorations the week before Spring Festival.
example.zh: 春节前一周我们挂装饰。

example.en: Grandma gives out red envelopes to all the kids.
example.zh: 奶奶给每个孩子发红包。

example.en: They light the lanterns on the fifteenth night.
example.zh: 十五晚上他们点灯笼。

example.en: We watched the fireworks from the roof.
example.zh: 我们在楼顶看烟花。

example.en: The kids set off firecrackers in the courtyard.
example.zh: 孩子们在院子里放鞭炮。

example.en: We eat mooncakes and drink tea.
example.zh: 我们吃月饼喝茶。

example.en: We watched a parade on National Day.
example.zh: 国庆节我们看了游行。

example.en: We exchange gifts on Christmas Eve.
example.zh: 平安夜我们互赠礼物。

example.en: We have a family dinner on New Year's Eve.
example.zh: 除夕我们吃团圆饭。

example.en: We celebrated my birthday at a hotpot place.
example.zh: 我们在火锅店给我过了生日。

example.en: She baked a cake for her son's birthday.
example.zh: 她给儿子烤了个生日蛋糕。

example.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
example.zh: 许个愿，吹灭蜡烛。

example.en: He wished for a new bike.
example.zh: 他许愿想要一辆新自行车。

example.en: I turned thirty last month.
example.zh: 我上个月满三十岁。

example.en: We all get older, but he refuses to admit it.
example.zh: 我们都会变老，但他不承认。

example.en: They threw a party for their anniversary.
example.zh: 他们为纪念日办了派对。

example.en: I gave her a present and she loved it.
example.zh: 我送了她一份礼物，她很喜欢。

example.en: Everyone sang happy birthday around the cake.
example.zh: 大家围着蛋糕唱生日歌。

example.en: I invited my colleagues to the party.
example.zh: 我请了同事来聚会。

example.en: Bring snacks if you're coming.
example.zh: 来的话带点零食。

example.en: Try to arrive on time; dinner starts at seven.
example.zh: 尽量准时到，七点开饭。

example.en: She greeted the guests at the door.
example.zh: 她在门口迎接客人。

example.en: I met a few new people at the party.
example.zh: 聚会上我认识了几个新朋友。

example.en: He told a joke and everyone laughed.
example.zh: 他讲了个笑话，大家都笑了。

example.en: We danced to the music until midnight.
example.zh: 我们跟着音乐跳到半夜。

example.en: Did you have fun at the party?
example.zh: 聚会上玩得开心吗？

example.en: We chatted until midnight and missed the last bus.
example.zh: 我们聊到半夜，错过了末班车。

example.en: We cleaned up afterwards and went home.
example.zh: 结束后我们打扫完才回家。

example.en: I picked out a gift for my mother-in-law.
example.zh: 我给婆婆挑了份礼物。

example.en: Can you wrap the present before we go?
example.zh: 走之前能把礼物包一下吗？

example.en: She tied a bow on the box.
example.zh: 她在盒子上系了个蝴蝶结。

example.en: Sign the card before we give it to her.
example.zh: 送给她之前先在卡上签名。

example.en: I sent a thank you note after the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼后我寄了张感谢卡。

example.en: The kids opened their presents at seven.
example.zh: 孩子们七点拆礼物。

example.en: He surprised his wife with a gift.
example.zh: 他给妻子准备了个惊喜礼物。

example.en: It took me a week to find the perfect gift.
example.zh: 我花了一周才找到合适的礼物。

example.en: Include a gift receipt so she can exchange it.
example.zh: 附上礼品收据，方便她换货。

example.en: I bought something for my dad's birthday.
example.zh: 我给爸爸的生日买了点东西。

example.en: We played a board game after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后我们玩了桌游。

example.en: We sit down to dinner together on Sundays.
example.zh: 周日我们一起坐下吃晚饭。

example.en: Everyone gathered around the table for hotpot.
example.zh: 大家围着桌子吃火锅。

example.en: We visit my grandparents every summer.
example.zh: 我们每年夏天去看爷爷奶奶。

example.en: He helps around the house without being asked.
example.zh: 他不用人说就帮忙做家务。

example.en: Grandpa tells family stories after dinner.
example.zh: 爷爷晚饭后讲家里的旧事。

example.en: The kids fight over the remote every night.
example.zh: 孩子们每晚抢遥控器。

example.en: We shared old photos at the reunion.
example.zh: 聚会上我们分享了老照片。

example.en: We grew up together in the same building.
example.zh: 我们在同一栋楼一起长大。

example.en: Let's take a family photo before dinner.
example.zh: 开饭前拍张全家福。

example.en: I feed the baby at six and ten.
example.zh: 我六点和十点喂宝宝。

example.en: He changed a diaper for the first time today.
example.zh: 他今天第一次换尿布。

example.en: She sings to the baby every night.
example.zh: 她每晚给宝宝唱歌。

entries.head: put someone down for a nap

example.en: I put him down for a nap at noon.
example.zh: 我中午哄他睡午觉。

example.en: We give the baby a bath before bed.
example.zh: 睡前我们给宝宝洗澡。

example.en: She kissed him good night and turned off the light.
example.zh: 她亲了他道晚安，然后关灯。

example.en: The kids played with blocks on the floor.
example.zh: 孩子们在地上玩积木。

example.en: Let's go to the playground after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后去游乐场吧。

example.en: I drop her off at school at eight.
example.zh: 我八点送她上学。

example.en: Grandma picks him up from school.
example.zh: 奶奶接他放学。

example.en: He asked her out after the meeting.
example.zh: 会后他约她出去。

example.en: I had a crush on a classmate for two years.
example.zh: 我暗恋一个同学两年。

example.en: My aunt set me up on a blind date.
example.zh: 我姑妈给我安排了一次相亲。

example.en: They fell in love during the trip.
example.zh: 他们在旅行中相爱了。

example.en: The couple held hands on the subway.
example.zh: 那对情侣在地铁上牵着手。

example.en: He's meeting her parents this weekend.
example.zh: 这周末他去见她父母。

example.en: They've been in a relationship for a year.
example.zh: 他们在一起一年了。

example.en: We talked and lost track of time.
example.zh: 我们聊着聊着忘了时间。

example.en: He popped the question at the restaurant.
example.zh: 他在餐厅求了婚。

example.en: She broke up with him last month.
example.zh: 她上个月和他分手了。

example.en: It's hard to make friends in a new city.
example.zh: 在新城市交朋友很难。

example.en: We stay in touch on WeChat.
example.zh: 我们在微信上保持联系。

example.en: I'm meeting up with an old friend tonight.
example.zh: 今晚我和老朋友约见面。

example.en: Don't worry; I have your back.
example.zh: 别担心，我支持你。

example.en: She was there for me when I lost my job.
example.zh: 我失业时她一直陪着我。

example.en: He always makes me laugh.
example.zh: 他总是逗我笑。

example.en: Can you help me out with the move?
example.zh: 搬家能帮我一把吗？

example.en: Can you keep a secret?
example.zh: 你能保守秘密吗？

example.en: We talked heart to heart for an hour.
example.zh: 我们谈了一个小时的心。
